basics.name: Ayo Pase
basics.label: I'm an IT Systems Engineer specializing in cloud-based identity, directory services, systems administration, enterprise IT infrastructure, endpoint management, and secure access operations.
basics.x_title: Hi There! Thank you for visiting my Page
basics.summary: Enterprise IT is where complexity meets accountability, and that's where I thrive. I'm Ayo, an IT professional specializing in building and maintaining secure, scalable enterprise environments. From endpoint management with Microsoft Intune and Autopilot to identity and access control with Active Directory, I keep systems running reliably and people productive. Whether it's Linux, Windows, or macOS administration or device security, I get things done right and under pressure.

work.position: Systems Engineer / Technical Support Engineer – L3
summary: Provided advanced L3 support across enterprise systems, identity services, and endpoint platforms including Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
Administered and maintained Active Directory, managing user accounts, group policies, permissions, and identity lifecycle operations.
Managed enterprise endpoint provisioning, compliance, and security using Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot for Windows users, and Kandji for macOS device management and policy enforcement.
Administered Okta for identity and access management, including user provisioning, SSO configuration, MFA policy enforcement, and access lifecycle operations.
Developed Bash and Python scripts to automate repetitive operational workflows and improve system reliability.
Monitored system health, performance metrics, and alerts using Datadog and Azure Monitor.
Troubleshot critical user-reported issues across multiple platforms, applying root-cause diagnostics to reduce repeat incidents.
Documented operational runbooks, support processes, and infrastructure procedures to maintain accurate knowledge bases.
Managed multiple queues of technical support cases, prioritizing issues based on severity and user impact.
Collaborated with Product Managers and QA teams to investigate internal tooling and platform issues.
Identified opportunities for workflow and functionality improvements across support tools and processes.
Drove impactful changes by working closely with internal support teams and external partners.
Owned cases through resolution or escalation, ensuring timely and accurate outcomes.
Investigated and triaged Facebook and Instagram product tooling issues, escalating complex cases to Tier 2 Technical Support Engineers.
Investigated and responded to urgent and sensitive inquiries in line with established guidelines and policies.
Led Master Control Room (MCR) operations and supervised live broadcast production teams.
Ensured production quality and system security by reviewing workflows and technical tools.
Provided hands-on technical support for broadcast systems including OBS, TriCaster, audio and video mixers, and Adobe Premiere.
Investigated urgent technical issues, dispatched field crews, and coordinated incident resolution.
Transformed operational metrics into insights that increased staff productivity by approximately 50%.
Identified domestic and global news trends to strengthen editorial planning and output.
Audited customer support tickets to ensure SLA compliance and documentation accuracy.
Delivered weekly quality assurance reports and provided coaching to support team members.
Led customer service improvement initiatives focused on service quality and consistency.
Provided hands-on IT support including PC upgrades, hardware troubleshooting, and system maintenance.
Handled password resets, user access issues, and hardware dispatching for end users.

projects.name: Ansible Lab – Linux Server Automation

Deployed and linked-cloned Ubuntu servers within a NAT network, configured static IPs via Netplan, disabled cloud-init DHCP overrides, and ran playbooks to install and configure Apache and MariaDB across managed nodes.

projects.name: OpenClaw Agent
projects.description: AI-powered Discord bot built with Node.js, Express, OpenAI GPT-4, and Discord.js. Exposes a REST API that forwards user prompts to OpenAI and sends AI-generated replies back to Discord. Runs inside a Docker container on Ubuntu via VMware Fusion on Mac M1.

projects.name: Network Design – Electric Petrol Site
